newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish arm of Colombia drugs ring smashed in raid.
newsitem.headline: Spanish arm of Colombia drugs ring smashed in raid.

text.p: Police said on Friday they had smashed the Spanish arm of a Colombian drugs ring, arresting nine people and seizing 700 kg (1,500 lb) of cocaine.
Two Colombians thought to be the Spanish representatives of Colombia's Cali drug cartel, and a policeman were among those arrested.

"This criminal organisation, an extension of the Cali cartel, was operating using a network of companies to transport consignments of drugs and distribute them throughout Spain," police said in a statement.
The drugs with a street value of around 6.5 billion pesetas ($48.5 million) were found in a lorry in Zaragoza and a warehouse in Barcelona during a week-long police operation.
